entities.name: Anton de Kom University of Suriname
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Anton de Kom University is the only university in Suriname. It is located in the capital, Paramaribo, and named for Anton de Kom, an anti-colonialist activist who was killed by the Nazis while in exile in the Netherlands.
